Subject: Skyloom — need conditional hold + sizing check for late-stage close

Team,

Skyloom is moving into final legal review and procurement has asked for a conditional GPU hold to guarantee the Nov 1 onboarding window. High level asks from GTM: 8–10 H100-like slots reserved (expected peak concurrency ~120 sessions, avg request size ~1.2k tokens/sess, expected token/sec ~5k) for the first 8 weeks of production. They also call out p95 latency targets around 600ms for their reranking flows.

Can infra confirm (a) whether we have a contiguous block that can be held across a US region for Nov 1–Nov 30, (b) the min lead time for changing held capacity, and (c) any trade-offs if we use A100 80GB vs H100 for cost/perf?

If we can place a conditional hold I want to send Skyloom a short MOU (one page) that our legal can attach to the PO — earliest we can commit is conditional on signed PO/DocuSign. Attaching baseline sizing notes as reference.

Please flag if this needs to root to a Dedicated pool or we can satisfy via burst/dedicated mix.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

> Team,
>
> Skyloom is moving into final legal review and procurement has asked for a conditional GPU hold to guarantee the Nov 1 onboarding window.

Quick snapshot from ops:
- us-west-2 (primary staging zone) has ~24 H100-equivalent slots currently uncommitted across the transient pool for Nov 1–30.
- us-west-2 also shows 16 A100 80GB nodes that can be used with slight perf delta (estimated +15–25% latency under the same batch profile).
- Reserved/Dedicated pools are ~60% utilized in Q4 forecasts; we can free up to ~12 additional slots by shifting noncritical burst workloads (48h lead time + ops approval).
- Cross-region reallocation to us-east-1 is possible but requires image sync and a 72–96h window for kernel/caching warmup.

Attachments: capacity_snapshot_sept01.pdf, slot_mapping_usw2.csv (mapping by host id + cuda capability).

Recommendation: For Skyloom's p95 target and their concurrency, H100 allocation in a single region is preferred. We can offer a conditional hold on 12 slots in us-west-2 immediately, with an option to escalate to 20 if PO is signed and we finalize a rollout timeline. If they insist on US-EAST residency we need to run the cross-region warm-up (72–96h) and prefer a hybrid dedicated/burst mix for cost containment.

Ben
